title: Page's Retreat
meta_description: Find the perfect Panama City Beach, FL vacation rental at Page's Retreat, a luxury 7-bed, 8.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 23 guests, this home house offers all the luxury amenities Panama City Beach has to offer. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Gulf Front w/ Views - Private Home Gym & Yoga Room - Wellness Room (Sauna, Steam, Cold Plunge) - Private Heated Pool and Hot Tub(Pool can be heated for an additional $ per day from October 1 - May 1) -Elevator -6 Seater Golf Cart Included & 6 Adult Bikes Experience a one-of-a-kind Gulf-front escape designed for total relaxation, recovery, and inspiration. This extraordinary beachfront home blends luxury living with a true wellness-forward lifestyle which is perfect for guests seeking rejuvenation without sacrificing comfort or style. Wake up to sweeping Gulf views and unwind in thoughtfully curated spaces that elevate mind and body. The home features a private home gym and dedicated yoga room, ideal for maintaining your routine while on vacation. After a workout, or a long day in the sun, retreat to the full-service wellness room, complete with a sauna, steam room, and cold plunge for the ultimate reset. Each of the seven uniquely themed bedrooms offers its own personality and ambiance, creating a memorable stay for families, groups, or retreats as well as ensuite bathrooms. Adding to the home’s distinct character, the property is owned by world-renowned WWE Hall of Famer and 3X WCW World Heavyweight Champion, Diamond Dallas Page, bringing an unmistakable legacy of performance, resilience, and wellness to the space. Whether you’re planning a restorative getaway, a wellness-focused retreat, an intimate wedding, or simply seeking an unforgettable Gulf-front vacation, this home offers an unparalleled experience where luxury meets longevity, right on the beach. Notes on home: 1st FL Private Home Gym Wellness Room (Sauna, Steam, Cold Plunge) 1 Full Bathroom Kitchenette Commercial Ice Maker 2nd FL 1 King Bedroom w/ Queen over bunk Kitchen Living Room w/ fireplace Yoga Room w/ fireplace (dining or dance room) 1/2 Bathroom 3rd FL 4 King Bedrooms with balconies (3 on Gulf w/ fireplaces) 1 King Bedroom with 2 Twins over bunk 1 King Bedroom with 1 Twin over bunk Laundry Room Sleeper sofa x 2 (Greece and Italy rooms) Additional twin Rollaway bed
